content.comment_body: Hello, could someone help me with this? [article_no] My [product_name] program includes two switches (F1 and F2) that activate different parts of the logic. I've built a main screen to display the activation status, using the ON/OFF states from a pulse relay. In simulation, I can see the message on both the [product_name] screen and the [product_name] operator device screen. However, after I upload the program, the message only appears on the [product_name] screen. All other messages show up on the operator device screen correctly. If I remove the I/O state info, the message appears on the operator device screen, but it's missing key details. What might be causing this? Thank you for your time.

Hi [user_name], If I'm understanding your problem correctly, you need to go to the message text block in your program and, in the "message destination" section, select where you want the message to appear. If you choose both ([product_name] and operator device), then the message should display on both screens.

Hi [user_name], As I mentioned before, simulation works fine—messages show on both [product_name] and operator device screens. But after uploading to the device, it's not displaying as expected. Here's a screenshot. [user_name] [screenshot info removed] New question: Is it possible to update the firmware of the operator device?

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing a problem where messages containing I/O state information are not visible on the operator device after the program is uploaded, even though they work in simulation. Other messages appear correctly. Adjusting the message by removing I/O state details brings visibility back but omits important data. User has confirmed typical configuration settings are properly selected.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants messages that include I/O state information to display consistently on both the [product_name] and the operator device, just as they do during simulation.
